# lmw profile views

Show who viewed your profile lately

### Synopsis

Show LinkedIn's overview of who viewed your profile: its count of views and the
viewers it names, latest first (one request). Free accounts see only a few names;
people browsing in private mode are counted, not named.

```
lmw profile views [flags]
```

